meta.note: Single source of truth for web, print and 3D. Colours are 8-bit sRGB hex; print values are the offset equivalents already proofed for the metal laminate.

paper.use: Background for every surface, page and poster

cream.use: Shell white, cards, the robot body

rose.use: Accent: heart ring, progress, section numbers. Max 15% of any field

rose-deep.use: Foil on metal, link text, emphasis on paper

rose-soft.use: Tinted ground, the paper band, quiet panels

peach.use: Warm secondary ground, feed 1, 48-sheet variant B

ink.use: Body copy, rules, wordmark on paper

muted.use: Captions, mono spec lines, secondary labels

line.use: 1 px hairlines, card borders, table rules

sage.use: Single utility accent: seal dot, 'local' status

cyber.use: The only eye colour. Emissive, never used as a flat brand field

metal.use: Soft-touch metal laminate, flat fill fallback

metal-dark.use: Metal hairline borders, brushed streaks, box edges

rules: No pure black and no pure white anywhere, including 3D backgrounds and PNG canvases.
rose is an accent, never a full-bleed field above 15 percent of area.
cyber exists only inside the visor as emissive light. It never fills a button, badge or headline.
Metal is rendered flat with a hairline brushed texture. No gradient sheen, no chrome, no mirror.
Every text colour pair must clear 4.5:1 against its own surface.
Sentence case for headlines. Uppercase only for mono spec labels with letter-spacing.
Never justify text. Max measure 68 characters.
The wordmark is set in the sans at 600 with 0.24em tracking, never in the mono.

shadow-gap.note: The signature gap under AMI's shell over the hidden silicone ring. Must be visible in front, 3/4 and low views.

rules: Honour prefers-reduced-motion: disable autoRotate, breathing and camera tweens.
Nothing pulses per second. The timer never animates.
One motion per interaction. No decorative loops on content.

product.name: AMI
product.form: Continuous ovoid with two bear ears on the top corners of the head, widest at the shoulders, tapering to a rounded base.

ears.position: top corners of the head, 69% out from centre
ears.construction: moulded into the same shell, no part line

visor.material: one-piece glossy #151112 glass, flush to the shell

eyes.note: Both eyes cyan. There is no second-eye colour and no halo.

mouth.note: No mouth, no nose, no vents, no speaker dots on the face. AMI speaks with light.

heart_ring.note: Base seam light. The only light needed in a dim room.

ports.microSD: under a flush cap on the base

claim_rules: Local-first. Audio comes from the microSD; nothing streams by default.
No medical, therapeutic or diagnostic claims of any kind.

packaging.type: Two-piece metal PR box with a paper band and a moulded pulp tray

shell.name: soft-touch metal laminate
shell.note: No plastic film wrap. No shrink sleeve.

emboss.use: ovoid outline with ears on the front; no ink

band.note: Carries the only outside copy and tears off in one piece.

tray.note: Holds AMI on its back, face up.

print.recycling_line: Metal shell · pulp tray · paper band · no film

contains: A small friend for big days, vertical, one colour
contents list on the opposite side

Paper band removed, pulp tray exposed
AMI lifted from the tray, 3mm shadow gap visible
Flat-lay: AMI, USB-C cable, quick start, microSD seated
